title: (No AI) Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
author: David Pierce
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/VRGVSST_0814_SIte.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Instagram's wordmark is iconic. Well, _was_ iconic. Apparently Instagram thought it looked old, so the company [rolled out a new one this week.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/979583/this-is-instagrams-new-logo) It doesn't look like the old Instagram wordmark. It doesn't even look like it spells Instagram anymore. And we cannot figure out why Instagram decided to do this.

On [this episode of _The Vergecast_](https://pod.link/vergecast), David and Nilay start by discussing the new logo, the executive urge to redesign everything all the time, and whether new is always better. After that, they get into the other big Meta release of the week: Mark Zuckerberg's [many-thousand-word missive](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/08/the-future-is-for-everyone/) on the future of AI. There are [a lot of ideas and proposals](https://www.theverge.com/tech/977395/meta-mark-zuckerberg-superintelligent-ai-ramble) …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/podcast/980367/instagram-logo-new-zuckerberg-ai-vergecast)

title: (No AI) You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Vector illustration of the Google Gemini logo](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/02/STK255_Google_Gemini_D.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With [the update](https://x.com/GeminiApp/status/2088277477672255830?s=20), you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow.

When toggled off, Google will remove the "sparkle" watermark that appears in the bottom-right corner of content generated with the company's Nano Banana and Omni models. Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible [SynthID watermarks](https://www.theverge.com/2023/8/29/23849107/synthid-google-deepmind-ai-image-detector) and [C2PA metadata](https://www.theverge.com/2024/8/21/24223932/c2pa-standard-verify-ai-generated-images-content-credentials) embedded in the background, [according to Josh Woodward](https://x.com/joshwoodward/status/2088259244193960386?s=20), the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio. That means you …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/980416/google-gemini-ai-watermarks-removal)
